name: thordin9/apotheke
description: Apotheke (ἀποθήκη): a fast, mobile-first PHP catalog for your stuff (SQLite or PostgreSQL)

suggest.ext-dom: SVG logo uploads in the Control Panel (sanitizer)
suggest.ext-imagick: HEIC/HEIF photos, and files GD cannot read. Transparent areas are flattened onto white and CMYK is converted to sRGB, matching GD. For a grayscale photo, Imagick writes a 1-channel JPEG, so that match is approximate. The Docker image includes Imagick with libheif; without it a HEIC upload is kept and shown as a placeholder
